notes: Encoded from this page's own text only. Page states a 7-character serial (1 letter + 6 digits), month from the 1st character letter via a chart, year from the 2nd-3rd digits. The month chart lives only in the image AirPac-Serial-Number-Nomenclature-Style-1.jpg (not in retrievable text), so this style ships YEAR-ONLY pending the image pass; no month table is imported from any other brand. Example is the page's own example serial; its expected year is derived from the page's stated year positions, not from a page-stated worked decode.

styles.notes: Page positions 2-3 (1-based) = year, converted to 0-based half-open [1,3]. Month = 1st position letter per chart image only, held for the image pass.
